review_notes: I read the whole file. I also checked the project-local definitions it wraps: EMP.IsEqualAreaWeight, PowerDiagram.bodyCellSet, PowerDiagram.bodyCellArea and BodySpace.toGeometryConvexBody. Every definition (solidBody, cellSet, cellArea, IsEqualAreaWeight, IsNormalizedEqualAreaWeight, normalizedWeight) is a named specialisation of an existing project-local fixed-body API. The module docstring says so. None of them is an independent reimplementation of a Mathlib, Batteries or core concept. The concepts involved (power cells, equal-area weights, subbody parameters) are specific to this development and have no Mathlib counterpart. The wrappers also change the parameter orientation to (hA, C, s, w), which is a legitimate choice. I did not search Mathlib exhaustively for related notions such as Voronoi or power diagrams, but nothing in the file suggests a competing concept. The theorems are standalone lemma wrappers, which the rubric excludes.
